messages:
incident-bot: [P1] Smart-routing oscillation detected — health-checks flapping across regions (us-east-1 <-> us-west-2 <-> eu-west-1). Multiple automated fallbacks in last 10m. Elevated 5xx and token latencies. Paging oncall: @bob

bob (oncall): on it. can someone drop a quick triage? severity and customers impacted?

alice (SRE): seeing ~180 fallbacks in 10m. healthcheck status toggles every ~30s between OK/UNHEALTHY for the worker pool serving model-variant "gptx-open-1.1-q". fallback policy tries next-best region then comes back, creating a loop.

carla (runtime): fyi we rolled a behind-the-scenes alias last night that maps traffic to gptx-open-1.1-q (quantized) in us-west and eu. variant init time is longer and sometimes fails readiness briefly. readiness probe threshold is tight (2s).

bob (oncall): confirmed. customer reports from support?

emily (support): 4 tenants opened realtime alerts: AcmePay (production), BrightLeaf (staging but hitting prod routes), NucleusAI (prod), StudentForms (dev). AcmePay reports 503 + long tails starting ~1763604000.

carla (runtime): immediate mitigations I propose:
1) disable automatic cross-region fallback for affected tenants (make routing sticky)
2) increase readiness probe/grace for the new variant
3) pin model alias to a single region until we stabilize

alice (SRE): agree. also will mute the fallback alert group to reduce noise while we remediate.

bob (oncall): do it. carla, can you run the sticky update? I'll coordinate with infra for healthchecks and we can roll back alias if needed.

carla (runtime): running command now:

```
redwoodctl routing update --tenant all --policy sticky --regions us-east-1 --reason "mitigate flapping gptx-open-1.1-q" --keep-origin=60s
```

carla (runtime): update submitted — targeting sticky to us-east-1 for 60s grace. deploy-bot: please confirm applied.

oncall-rotation-bot: Action logged. Routing policy change by carla scheduled and applied to route groups: rg-core-1, rg-core-2.

deploy-bot: routing-change accepted. change-id=chg_20260316_1102_routing. Applying to 6 route groups.

dave (infra): increasing readiness probe threshold on worker pools serving the alias (from 2s -> 8s). patching healthcheck config across us-west-2 and eu-west-1 now. command:

```
kubectl patch deploy redwood-runtime -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runtime","livenessProbe":{"initialDelaySeconds":5,"periodSeconds":10},"readinessProbe":{"timeoutSeconds":8}}]}}}}'
```

alice (SRE): muting fallback alerts for 30m to avoid escalation storms.

emily (support): AcmePay says errors decreased after sticky routing applied. still seeing occasional 502s but volume is down.

bob (oncall): good. next: root cause verification — is this purely readiness/variant init? any model mismatch issues?

carla (runtime): digging into runtime logs: when quantized variant spins up, kv-cache warmup triggers occasional timeouts in the healthcheck path. also found a policy mismatch: policy selector allowed model-variant substitution across regions even if variant configs differ. so two problems: variant with longer init + policy too permissive.

eng-runtime-lead: we need short-term and long-term actions. short-term = keep sticky for affected tenants + bump probe. long-term = ensure variant compatibility check before cross-region fallback and add random backoff to avoid synchronized fallbacks.

bob (oncall): I'll update incident status to P1 and notify customers. carla, leave sticky in place until eng-runtime-lead confirms fallback safety.

carla (runtime): acknowledged. pinning involved tenants to us-east-1 now:

```
redwoodctl tenant update --tenant AcmePay --route-region us-east-1 --notes "pin during flapping incident"
```

carla (runtime): pinned AcmePay + NucleusAI + BrightLeaf. StudentForms is dev so left alone.

bob (oncall): handing off active oncall to carla for the next 2 hours — I'm taking incident comms with customers. carla, if you need infra escalation ping dave.

oncall-rotation-bot: Handoff: bob -> carla at 1763605600. Escalation window set to 2h.

alice (SRE): observed healthcheck flaps drop to <5 in last 10m after changes. latency to token completion for AcmePay returned to baseline.

emily (support): AcmePay confirmed: errors have stopped, they appreciate the quick response. Marking as degraded but stabilizing.

dave (infra): we'll follow up with a rolling rollback of the alias mapping for the quantized variant in us-west/eu until we harden readiness. also scheduling a canary with an extended grace window.

eng-runtime-lead: postmortem items:
- fix policy selector to require variant-compatibility metadata for cross-region substitution
- add randomized backoff to fallback decision to prevent global oscillation
- add integration test for variant init timing + healthcheck
- update runbook for sticky-routing mitigation steps (include redwoodctl snippets)

bob (oncall): creating incident ticket INC-20260316-01 and assigning postmortem to eng-runtime team. I'll circulate update to impacted customers with timeline and mitigation summary.

carla (runtime): leaving sticky routing in effect for the pinned tenants. will monitor and gradually re-enable cross-region fallback only after variant compatibility checks pass.

alice (SRE): unmuting non-critical alerts. keeping fallback alerting on for new tenants only.

emily (support): closing customer open cases as resolved after confirmation from AcmePay.

bob (oncall): incident status -> Stabilized. will convert to Postmortem and schedule a 1hr blameless review tomorrow. thank you team :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident stabilized. Summary: Region fallback loop caused by quantized model-variant slower readiness + permissive routing policy. Mitigations: sticky routing, increased readiness timeout, pinned tenants, rollback plan. Next step: postmortem assigned to eng-runtime.

carla (runtime): quick note — saved diagnostics archive to s3://redwood-incidents/1763604821/diag.tgz for the postmortem.

eng-runtime-lead: good work. we'll own the long-term fixes and update runbooks.

bob (oncall): handing back to normal rotation. oncall-rotation-bot, resume normal schedule.

oncall-rotation-bot: Handoff complete. Returned to normal rotation at 1763606825."
